message:
Let me check if upx is already built and how to build it:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'ls /gt/_work/src/build* 2>/dev/null; ls /gt/_work/src/CMakeCache.txt 2>/dev/null; find /gt/_work -name "upx" -type f 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls /gt/_work/src/src/ | head -30'</parameter>
